title: Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.26962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. translated_title: Packora：生成式分子晶体结构预测的系统化设计
translated_abstract: 分子晶体结构预测（CSP）在制药、农用化学品和有机电子领域至关重要，其中分子构象和堆积的细微差异会强烈影响材料性质。我们提出了Packora，一种基于流的生成式模型，用于分子CSP，能够从分子图联合预测原子坐标和晶格。Packora支持多组分和有机金属晶体，并可在单个模型中对分子构象子集、立体化学标签和空间群信息的任意组合进行条件化。受CCDC CSP盲测启发，我们分别评估生成和排序，使用生成来隔离生成器质量，排序则用于衡量在通用松弛和排序流程下的端到端性能。我们还系统地研究了架构、训练、条件化、推理和扩展，确定了一种基于可缓存成对推理的有效设计。
tldr: Packora提出了一种基于流的生成式模型，系统化设计并联合预测原子坐标和晶格，支持多组分和有机金属晶体，并通过分离评估生成与排序来优化分子晶体结构预测性能。
en_tdlr: Packora introduces a flow-based generative model with systematic design that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and lattice, supports multi-component and organometallic crystals, and improves molecular crystal structure prediction by separately evaluating generation and ranking.
